integrity: Every formula follows from the explicitly defined 16-state transfer matrix, its exact integer characteristic polynomials and the primitive recurrent component. Included verification code is a reproducible check, not independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform J>0 antiferromagnetic Ising energy, zero-temperature weak one-spin local minima on labeled circular ladders C_n square K_2, n>=3; no claim about global ground states, finite-temperature dynamics, or dynamical absorption when neutral flips are allowed. The h/J=3 prism independent-set count was previously known. Historical originality is provisional.
title: Critical-field entropy spikes for one-spin metastability on cyclic Ising ladders
